title: Production of jet-fuel precursors from volatile fatty acids using metal oxide-supported zeolitic catalysts
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00930H, Paper
Adrián Lago, Lorenzo Bertin, Gonzalo A. Martinez, Emma Jones, Jacopo De Maron, Tommaso Tabanelli, Fabrizio Cavani, Cristina González-Fernández, David P. Serrano, Inés Moreno
MeO2/zeolite catalysts were tested in vapor-phase hexanoic acid ketonization. TiO2/H-β showed the best catalytic behavior, with high 6-undecanone yield (>60 mol C %) and strong resistance to deactivation with a real biogenic substrate.
